organization: World Bank Group / Republic of Korea
notes: World Bank Korea country overview describes Korea as a leader in digital innovation and green growth hosting an integrated WBG office re-established in 2013, 'now a global center for innovation and technology for sustainable development'; Korea–World Bank Partnership Facility and trust funds channel Korean expertise to client countries; since 2013 IFC has supported 60+ cross-border projects with $10.2 billion in commitments (incl. mobilized funds) in renewable energy, electric mobility, digital infrastructure and MSME finance; MIGA has provided $560 million in guarantees for Korean investors in renewable energy, agribusiness and infrastructure. This reflects Korea's outward investment role more than domestic resilience spending — domestic hazard exposure not quantified on this page.
recommended_action: Engage the WBG Korea Office and Korean green-growth institutions (e.g. GGGI-style partners) to position Talaix's multi-hazard intelligence as an analytics component for Korea-financed climate and infrastructure projects abroad.
